title: Template Launchpad: Preview & README Visuals for Template Apps
creator: Ava Kim
description: Create a cohesive set of onboarding visuals and README diagrams for the new Template Launchpad apps. Deliverables include hi-fidelity desktop and mobile screenshots for 3 templates (chat assistant, summarizer, embeddings demo), an annotated README architecture diagram (API call flow, auth/key usage, model routing), a sequence diagram for first-run experience, and a lightweight sprite sheet for docs thumbnails. Visuals must follow Redwood brand, be optimized for MD docs and Console gallery, and include accessible alt text and copy-ready captions.
acceptance_criteria: Three desktop screenshots per template exported at 1440px width and 800px height PNG
Mobile responsive screenshots (iPhone 14) for primary CTA flows exported as PNG
Annotated README architecture SVG with labeled components: client -> Redwood API -> model variant routing -> KV cache -> response streaming
Sequence diagram PNG for first-run onboarding (signup, API key set, demo run) with step annotations
Sprite sheet (PNG) containing 6 thumbnail states and a JSON manifest mapping coordinates
Figma file with named frames and export presets shared to #design-assets, and links added to the ticket
Design reviewed and approved by PM (Priya Nair) and engineering reviewer (Liam O'Connor)
tasks: Audit existing template screenshots and identify gaps
Design new UI states for first-run experience and empty-state onboarding panels
Create architecture diagram with simplified infra and callouts for private/dedicated differences
Generate mobile variants and alt text for each screenshot
Export assets, optimize for web (lossless PNG where possible), and assemble sprite sheet
Upload assets to Drive and link in ticket; open PR to add images to docs repo
